description: Exact tandem repeats (e.g. ATGATGATG): every maximal run of a primitive unit of length minUnitLength..maxUnitLength with >= minRepetitions complete copies, reported once at its left end (ATATATAT = AT x4 at 0, not also ATAT x2); ordered by unit length then start; 0-based. Facade over RepeatFinder.FindMicrosatellites (Kolpakov-Kucherov maximal repetitions). IUPAC input (e.g. N runs of an assembly) is accepted: only units made of A/C/G/T repeat, a window containing N or another ambiguity code never forms a repeat. canonicalRotation=true reports the lexicographically least rotation of each unit (Booth 1980; groups ATG / TGA / GAT) as unit and the unit as spelled in the sequence as originalUnit; position and repetitions are unchanged. Approximate (interrupted) repeats: find_approximate_tandem_repeats (TRF).

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive). A repeat unit must be spelled with A/C/G/T only, so windows with N never form a repeat.

maxUnitLength.description: Optional maximum repeat-unit length (>= minUnitLength); omit for no upper bound (a unit longer than length / minRepetitions can never repeat).

canonicalRotation.description: Report each unit as its lexicographically least rotation (Booth 1980) instead of the spelling at the run's left end; originalUnit then holds the actual spelling. Default false.

originalUnit.description: canonicalRotation only: the unit as spelled in the sequence at position

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
Minimum repeat-unit length must be at least 1
Maximum repeat-unit length must be at least minUnitLength

examples.name: Mononucleotide run AAAAA (unit 1) — A x5 only (AA x2 is a non-primitive tiling of the same run)
